claim: Elected to the Nassau County Legislature in 2015
finding: His 2024 Patch candidate profile lists Nassau County Legislator 2015–2022 and State Senate from 2023.

claim: Volunteer firefighter for 30 years; Wantagh unit honored for heroism during Superstorm Sandy
finding: His official Senate biography repeats the 30-year Wantagh firefighter service and Sandy honor, but that is also self-written. No independent record of the honor was found.

claim: Proposed and passed over $100 million in tax and fee cuts for Nassau residents
finding: The same figure appears in his official Senate biography. No itemized list of the cuts was found, so the total cannot be checked.

claim: Has never voted for a tax increase
finding: A negative claim about a 10-year voting record; no compiled record was found to test it.

claim: Nassau was the first county in the nation to address antisemitism with legislation against the BDS movement
finding: Nassau did pass an anti-BDS local law (Local Law 3-2016), and Rhoads has cited his role in it. No source confirmed it was the first county to do so.

claim: Created the Office of the Crime Victim Advocate and an Independent Inspector General
finding: Not independently checked in this core review.
